comparison.objective: Transfer five salmon pieces to a plate without robot-food contact; candidate finishes installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Repositioning and stabilizing a board while sweeping with a knife versus coaxial mandrel placement, impact control, and tiny metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All five pieces on plate, with any direct robot contact invalidating the score versus four fractures and complete containment without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Shared tool use and bimanual stabilization are generic; sweeping loose food is not impact fracture or precision fastener finishing. No separate spec versions were provided.
